habitat.description:
The polar bear reigns over the frozen realm of the Arctic, a marine mammal as much at home on drifting sea ice as on solid ground. These apex predators depend on the seasonal formation and breakup of sea ice to access the seals that form the foundation of their diet.

Across the vast expanse of the Arctic Ocean, polar bears patrol the edges of ice floes, waiting motionless beside breathing holes for hours until a ringed seal surfaces. The sea ice is not merely their hunting platform but their entire world, a shifting, cracking, refreezing landscape that determines where they can feed, mate, and travel.

In summer, as the ice retreats, polar bears are forced ashore in some regions, fasting for months while waiting for freeze-up. The lengthening ice-free season, driven by climate change, represents an existential challenge for a species evolved to exploit the frozen interface between ocean and atmosphere.

threats.name: Sea Ice Loss
threats.description: Arctic sea ice is declining at approximately 13% per decade, directly reducing the platform polar bears need to hunt seals.

threats.name: Climate Change
threats.description: Rising Arctic temperatures are melting sea ice earlier and forming it later, extending the fasting period beyond what many bears can survive.

threats.name: Pollution
threats.description: Persistent organic pollutants concentrate in Arctic food webs, accumulating to toxic levels in polar bear tissues.

threats.name: Industrial Development
threats.description: Oil and gas exploration, shipping, and mining in the Arctic disturb bears and risk catastrophic oil spills.

threats.name: Human-Bear Conflict
threats.description: As bears spend more time on land near communities, dangerous encounters increase, often ending fatally for the bear.

key_programs: Agreement on Conservation of Polar Bears (1973)

cultural_significance.cinema: Polar bears became the defining image of climate change through documentaries showing them stranded on shrinking ice.
cultural_significance.literature: Philip Pullman's armoured bears and countless children's books have made polar bears among the most familiar wild animals.
cultural_significance.mythology: Central to Inuit cosmology as Nanuq, the polar bear is a spiritual being deserving of profound respect.
cultural_significance.media_presence: From Coca-Cola advertisements to climate campaigns, the polar bear is perhaps the most recognizable conservation icon.
cultural_significance.cultural_paradox: The ultimate symbol of climate crisis belongs to a region most people will never visit, creating emotional distance from the emergency.

tmdb_media.title: Infinitely Polar Bear
tmdb_media.overview: A manic-depressive mess of a father tries to win back his wife by attempting to take full responsibility of their two young, spirited daughters, who don't make the overwhelming task any easier.

tmdb_media.title: Polar Bear
tmdb_media.overview: A new mother’s memories of her own youth prepare her to navigate motherhood in the increasingly challenging world that polar bears face today.

tmdb_media.title: Alaska Polar Bear
tmdb_media.overview: As an adult film director, Tae-joon is called a polar bear because he has a low-talking personality but has a big body and voice when excited. Because of his lustful father, he thinks only of women as a tool to quench her sexual desire. He is currently running a cafe with coffee he learned to soothe the mind and body. He has an uninspiring sex life with the erotic actress Do Do-hee, his sex partner. On the other hand, one day when Yeon-hee, the youngest member of the Alaska directing department, works at Tae-Jun's cafe, Tae-Jun can't stand his sexual desire and violates her...

tmdb_media.title: Polar Bear
tmdb_media.overview: Polar Bear pursues an act of violence as it ricochets through time. From Aaron as a young boy first encountering the bear, to ten years on, where his own rage finally explodes. Then over four more years on, a now young adult Aaron encounters Lea, both bound to and haunted by the same ghost of violence.

tmdb_media.title: Polar Bear
tmdb_media.overview: Heriberto gives a lift to a school reunion to two friends (Flor and Trujillo). In the way, we find out that they were his worst bullies.

tmdb_media.title: Inner Polar Bear
tmdb_media.overview: A moving depiction of the alternative human and animal perspectives on the implications of climate change.

tmdb_media.title: Polar Bear
tmdb_media.overview: The polar bear and the brown bear are playing hide and seek in the snow.

tmdb_media.title: Polar Bear
tmdb_media.overview: All of a man's possessions start to disappear.

tmdb_media.title: The Little Polar Bear
tmdb_media.overview: This charming animated adventure follows a young polar bear, Lars, as he befriends Robbie, a seal. Together, these two form a friendship that proves different breeds of animals can get along perfectly well.

tmdb_media.title: Little Polar Bear
tmdb_media.overview: Based on the beloved book, the polar bear cub Lars floats away on a patch of ice and ends up in Africa, where, with the help of his new friends, he finds a way back home to his papa at the North Pole.

tmdb_media.title: The Polar Bear
tmdb_media.overview: Four characters become involved in one dramatic story: Nico has a mission to drive a car containing a live bomb to a specified destination, park the car and escape as quickly as she can. Leo has become his client's target, having carried out a "contract" that unfortunately had already been cancelled. Fabian and Reza want to enjoy themselves without any money, bringing themselves into contact sooner or later with the police. Sooner or later all four will meet up in dramatic circumstances....

tmdb_media.title: Polar Bear Safari
tmdb_media.overview: Polar Bear Safari follows Randy, a wealthy trophy hunter on a 15-day hunting expedition in search of a polar bear and discusses the reliance of the Inuit on guiding these hunting trips to keep the community living in Resolute Bay in the Canadian Arctic where unemployment is high. The local Inuits selling their bear hunting licenses to wealthy hunters to help combat their financial woes.

tmdb_media.title: Polar Bear Country
tmdb_media.overview: In the northern reaches of Manitoba, resting on the edge of Canada’s Hudson Bay, sits the small town of Churchill. Home to fewer than 1000 year-round residents, Churchill is a remarkable place: it plays host to an annual beluga whale migration, is visited by the Northern Lights over 300 times per year, and sits in a pristine tundra that truly embodies the term “wilderness”. Churchill’s most famous visitor, however, is the mighty Polar Bear. Every year, hundreds of bears gather on the shoreline surrounding Churchill, awaiting the sea ice that forms on Hudson Bay during winter. Once it forms, they’ll use it as a platform from which to hunt seals, but until then, they wait on the coast, creating a fascinating, and potentially dangerous, interaction between the residents of Churchill and the world’s largest land carnivore.

tmdb_media.title: Polar Bears: Ice Bear
tmdb_media.overview: An enthralling look at the Arctic's biggest predator on ice, capturing rarely-seen behavior, and featuring breathtaking cinematography shot over 12 months in the Canadian Arctic.

tmdb_media.title: The Polar Bear
tmdb_media.overview: The Polar Bear (Lucius) has an adventure that turns into a bloody battle.

tmdb_media.title: Polar Bear Love
tmdb_media.overview: Paul has won two tickets to Taiwan. He decides to try speed dating to find someone to take with him and finds more than he expected.

tmdb_media.title: Polar Bear
tmdb_media.overview: A Jewish man who escapes a Nazi transport hides in a Polish ski resort town by posing for photos with tourists dressed as a polar bear.

tmdb_media.title: Polar Bear Summer
tmdb_media.overview: The uncommon sight of polar bears wandering a colorful landscape during an iceless summer in Hudson Bay, Canada.

tmdb_media.title: The Polar Bear Club
tmdb_media.overview: A stubborn old man struggles with the changes and loss that occur as he and his group of close friends near their life's final chapter.
